description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayNodeSession component in the OpenClawKit project. It includes mock implementations of WebSocket tasks and sessions, test cases for connection handling, token storage, URL normalization, and event streaming.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking used to simulate WebSocket interactions during testing.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketSessioning to manage mock WebSocket tasks.

classes.name: SeqGapProbe
classes.description: An actor used to detect sequence gap events during stream testing.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSessionTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the GatewayNodeSession component, covering connection, token handling, URL normalization, timeout behavior, and event streaming.

methods.name: scannedSetupCodePrefersBootstrapAuthOverStoredDeviceToken
methods.description: Test that verifies bootstrap token is preferred over stored device token during setup.

methods.name: bootstrapHelloStoresAdditionalDeviceTokens
methods.description: Test ensuring additional device tokens from bootstrap hello are stored correctly.

methods.name: nonBootstrapHelloStoresPrimaryDeviceTokenButNotAdditionalBootstrapTokens
methods.description: Test that verifies primary device token is stored when bootstrap token is not used.

methods.name: untrustedBootstrapHelloDoesNotPersistBootstrapHandoffTokens
methods.description: Test that untrusted bootstrap hello responses do not persist bootstrap tokens.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlPreservesExplicitSecureCanvasPort
methods.description: Test that URL normalization preserves explicitly specified secure ports.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlBackfillsGatewayHostForLoopbackCanvas
methods.description: Test that URL normalization correctly backfills the gateway host for loopback URLs.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsUnderlyingResponseBeforeTimeout
methods.description: Test that invokeWithTimeout returns the proper response if completed before the timeout.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsTimeoutError
methods.description: Test that invokeWithTimeout returns a timeout error if the operation exceeds the specified timeout.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutZeroDisablesTimeout
methods.description: Test that passing zero disables the timeout in invokeWithTimeout.

methods.name: emitsSyntheticSeqGapAfterReconnectSnapshot
methods.description: Test to ensure a synthetic sequence gap event is emitted after reconnecting and snapshot processing.
